semantics.p1y: (p1a AND p1b AND p1c) OR (p1d AND p1e AND p1f)
semantics.timing: Combinational continuous outputs; no clock or cycle latency. Evidence: original describes four AND gates and two OR gates and permits assign statements.
semantics.reset: None: original interface contains no reset.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified initial value; outputs follow gate evaluation of current inputs.

numeric.widths: All inputs and outputs are one bit, as explicitly specified.
numeric.operations: Bitwise AND and OR; no arithmetic, signed interpretation, truncation, or overflow.
numeric.unknowns: Use standard SystemVerilog four-state gate semantics; original specifies no special X/Z handling.

verification.oracle: From original gate definitions: binary output is true when either corresponding group has every input high; independent equality predicates.
verification.coverage: Exhaustive 1024 binary vectors including all-zero, all-one, isolated groups, and cross-output independence.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait 1 ns for combinational settling; no original waveform timing exists.
verification.success: Explicit PASS line only after every vector passes.
